dom-truth.why: ThemeToggle.tsx uses useSyncExternalStore with a MutationObserver on documentElement's data-theme and reads root.dataset.theme on click, so changes from chart.js hc=1 or theme-boot.js are reflected, and the message explains this.

themechange-event.why: The toggle handler dispatches new CustomEvent('themechange', { detail: next }) on document, matching the original.

boot-script.why: theme-boot.js is untouched and not moved into React; the diff only adds src/ files and the message says index.html still loads the old scripts.

a11y.why: The button keeps id, aria-pressed={dark}, and the 'Light mode'/'Dark mode' label toggling, which the message confirms.

persist.why: toggle calls localStorage.setItem('theme', next) as the original did.

no-silent-changes.why: The one behaviour change, the label now updating on external data-theme changes via MutationObserver, is explicitly called out in the message, along with the unbuilt/untested state and the required index.html and bundler steps.
